title: Robert Maxwell and Nazi tech transfer

tellings.quote: basically like helped invent peer review, scientific peer review, was also in charge of Nazi tech transfer

plain: Robert Maxwell, a British publisher, is said both to have helped invent scientific peer review, the system where experts check each other's work before it is published, and to have been in charge of the handover of Nazi technology. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, in an episode with Tim Alberino, a man who claims a giant was captured in Afghanistan.
